## Disputes

- [Overview](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/disputes/overview): Managing disputes via the API is only available to merchants who can access disputes in the Braintree Control Panel.
- [Managing](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/disputes/managing/): Managing disputes via the API is only available to merchants who can access disputes in the Braintree Control Panel.
- [Evidence Requirements](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/disputes/evidence-requirements/): Certain - ones related to fraud and to merchandise/services not received - have very specific evidence requirements: 1.
- [Automating Dispute Management](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/disputes/automating/): Managing disputes via the API is only available to merchants who can access disputes in the Braintree Control Panel.
